action.objective: Escape the check with the king, choosing the square that minimizes immediate tactical risk while keeping the king active against the unfavorable material deficit.
action.rationale: Only three legal moves; f1f3 is proven refuted (Qxf3#). Both e4d3 and e4e3 are commit_ready, share equal deep evidence (-99994 at depth 3/2-3) but each carries a proven short tactical refutation via Rf3 (mate in 2). unavoidable_mate is true: every legal move loses to bounded short mates, so no truly safe move exists. e4e3 keeps the king nearer the center and its defenders (d2) while e4d3 exposes it to more open lines; both are equally refuted, so I pick e4e3 to avoid the Bxc2+ tempo and keep the king less exposed to Rxf1/Qxf1 follow-ups.
